title: Four years later, KU researchers continue their work strengthening American dams
summary_en: Nearly four years after launching a federally funded research initiative to strengthen American dams and levees, University of Kansas engineers are demonstrating how that work is delivering measurable benefits to Kansas infrastructure, workforce development and public safety.
title_cn: Four years later, KU researchers continue their work strengthening American dams

title: KU-based initiative helps build safer community for Wyandotte County youth
summary_en: A new study demonstrates effective ways to reduce youth violence, with a 42% decrease in the rate of youth homicide within the catchment area served during the years of the KU-based program.
title_cn: KU-based initiative helps build safer community for Wyandotte County youth
